about: The Velopack source this repo builds its Windows helpers (setup, update, stub) from, with no-process-scan.patch applied. Velopack's stock helpers open every running process on each install, update and uninstall (src/bins/src/shared/util_windows.rs, lines 46-60 at this commit), which would reach the game. Design decision (2026-11-17): build Velopack's helpers from its MIT source with that scan removed. A new Velopack version is taken only after its source is read again and this file names it (docs/build.md, "Velopack's helpers").
